property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always completes (does not revert) when all callee calls succeed; the mutant that unconditionally reverts causes transfer to revert for some inputs (e.g., any non-empty _tos), breaking this property.
change_summary: Change the call target from caddress.call(...) to reverting before the call by inserting a revert() statement replacing the call expression, causing the function to always revert during the first iteration.
